title: From Bagging Groceries to $232.5 Million
description:
A former grocery bagger's tour made 232.5 million dollars.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Bad Bunny: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bad_Bunny

From Wikipedia (Bad Bunny): after high school he worked part-time as a bagger and cashier at a supermarket while creating music; his World's Hottest Tour became the highest-grossing tour by a Latin artist in history, earning US$232.5 million by October 4, 2022; he was the most-streamed artist of the year on Spotify four times between 2020 and 2025; a Moody's Analytics estimate expected his Puerto Rico residency to have a direct economic impact of $250 million; in 2019 he and Marc Anthony donated $1.6 million to rebuild Puerto Rican baseball fields. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: A former grocery bagger's tour made 232.5 million dollars.
In Puerto Rico, he bagged groceries part-time. And made music.
Then Spotify's most-streamed artist. Four times.
That 2022 tour? The biggest ever for a Latin artist.
Then a home show run, expected to bring Puerto Rico 250 million.
And he gave 1.6 million dollars to rebuild baseball fields.
